\question[2] Which of these numbers is prime?

% ── Question 8 ──
\question[3] In one or two sentences, explain why the sum of two odd numbers is always even.
\begin{solution}
An odd number is $2a+1$ and another is $2b+1$; their sum is $2(a+b+1)$, a multiple of 2.
\end{solution}
\begin{marking}{Start at zero.}
\rubric{+1}{Says odd numbers are one more than an even number (or writes \$2k+1\$)}
\rubric{+2}{Adds them and shows the sum is a multiple of 2}
\end{marking}
\ScanID{ihhc2frz.space}\answerspace{4cm}
